label: Best Buy Canada Marketplace
terms_note: Seller applies to Best Buy Canada (registered Canadian business, Canadian return address per M2E's summary); the Mirakl shop API key is only issued once the seller account is approved; Mirakl rate limits are per marketplace (429 + Retry-After); no public seller fee schedule opened.

discovery.auth: api_key (Mirakl shop API key generated in the Best Buy Canada seller portal after approval; `Authorization: <key>` header)
sdks: Mirakl publishes the Seller API as OpenAPI 3 (developer.mirakl.com/content/product/mmp/rest/seller/openapi3); connectors: M2E Mirakl Connect, SPS Commerce, Rithum

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **medium** — Best Buy Canada's seller pages returned 403; the Mirakl platform fact and the Seller API were co
auth: 1. Apply to sell on Best Buy Canada Marketplace; wait for approval.
2. In the Mirakl seller back-office generate the shop API key (Settings › API key).
3. Send it as `Authorization: <api key>` on every HTTPS request to the marketplace's Mirakl host; scopes are shop roles (e.g. ROLE_SHOP_ADMIN, ROLE_PARTNER_OFFER_WRITE).

endpoints.purpose: import CSV/XML/XLSX to create / update / delete offers

endpoints.notes: sku, product id, price, quantity, state, logistic class

endpoints.purpose: create products in the operator catalogue

reference.limits: Mirakl returns 429 with Retry-After when the marketplace's limit is exceeded; the numeric limit is set per operator and not published on the portal. - Marketplace seller agreement with Best Buy Canada; approval before API access. - Mirakl API guidelines: HTTPS only, tolerate new fields / enum values, use HTTP status codes.
mcp_sdk: SDK: Mirakl publishes the Seller API as OpenAPI 3 (developer.mirakl.com/content/product/mmp/rest/seller/openapi3); connectors: M2E Mirakl Connect, SPS Commerce, Rithum

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Shop API key generated in the Best Buy Canada (Mirakl) seller portal once the seller account is approved; sent verbatim as the Authorization header (no Bearer prefix).

config_fields.name: instance_host
config_fields.help: Host of Best Buy Canada's Mirakl marketplace without scheme, as shown in your Best Buy Canada seller portal (e.g. marketplace.bestbuy.ca); every call goes to https://<instance_host>/api/...

config_fields.name: shop_id
config_fields.help: Numeric shop id, only when your API key's user has access to several shops (sent as ?shop_id= on every call; the default shop is used otherwise).

me.note: A01 GET /api/account returns the shop {shop_id, shop_name, shop_state, currency_iso_code, channels, contact_informations, ...}. Mirakl's documented maximum usage for A01 is once per day.

list_orders.note: OR11 GET /api/orders?order_state_codes&start_date(ISO-8601 creation date)&offset&max(default 10, max 100). `status` is a comma-separated list of STAGING|WAITING_ACCEPTANCE|WAITING_DEBIT|WAITING_DEBIT_PAYMENT|SHIPPING|SHIPPED|TO_COLLECT|RECEIVED|CLOSED|REFUSED|CANCELED. Returns {orders[], total_count}; the order lines, customer and shipping address are in raw.

mark_shipped.note: OR23 PUT /api/orders/{order_id}/tracking {carrier_code, tracking_number} records the carrier tracking of the order. `carrier` must be a carrier code registered on the marketplace (see CH11/SH21 carriers). Confirming the shipment itself is a separate call (OR24 PUT /api/orders/{order_id}/ship) that this tool does not make, so the order stays in SHIPPING until it is validated.

not_offered.create_listing: OF24 POST /api/offers requires product_id + product_id_type (the marketplace product the offer attaches to) and state_code for every offer ('Required at offer creation'); the vocabulary has no product reference or offer condition.
not_offered.update_listing: OF24 POST /api/offers is the only JSON offer write and replaces the whole offer: 'You must send all offer fields. Offer fields that are not sent are reset to their default value' (quantity 'if not provided, will be set to 0', description deleted), so a partial update would wipe the offer.
not_offered.end_listing: Offers are deleted through OF24 with update_delete=delete, whose schema still requires price, product_id, product_id_type and state_code for the offer; the vocabulary only carries the listing id.
not_offered.set_inventory: Stock-only updates are STO01 (multipart CSV stock file import) or a full OF24 offer replacement ('quantity ... if not provided, will be set to 0' and every other unsent field reset); neither is a single JSON stock call.

evidence: host marketplace.bestbuy.ca: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
